one_line: Founder of the Salastambha line in Kamarupa, navigating the transition after Bhaskaravarman while grounding new power in local traditions.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, lean but sturdy build with a wrestler’s shoulders and a cultivator’s forearms.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium-brown Assamese complexion, straight nose, slightly broad jaw, sharp dark-brown eyes with thick brows; a faint horizontal scar on the left cheek; default expression is calm, observant and slightly wary, softening into a small, reassuring half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight black hair to just below the shoulders, neatly parted and drawn back into a low knot at the nape, secured with a plain bronze pin; a simple dark-red cloth band (narrow turban strip) wrapped once around the forehead, tied at the back with short tails.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate Kamarupa noble attire: an off-white, knee-length cotton tunic with half sleeves and a subtle woven border; over it a deep-forest-green, mid-thigh-length silk angavastra-style outer cloth draped over the left shoulder and under the right arm, its edges trimmed with narrow gold and red geometric patterns; a tightly wrapped reddish-brown cotton dhoti, pleated in front and tied securely at the waist, falling to the ankles; a broad dark-brown leather belt with a simple rectangular bronze buckle worn over the tunic to hold his sword; on his feet, brown leather sandals with toe loops; accessories include a single slender gold armlet on the right upper arm, a plain bronze bangle on the left wrist, small round gold ear studs, and a beaded necklace of alternating dark wooden and copper-toned beads; all textiles look handwoven, slightly textured rather than glossy.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved iron sword of eastern Indian style with a single edge and plain bronze hilt, housed in a dark-brown leather scabbard reinforced with bronze bands, worn angled at his left hip and often held resting in his right hand with the scabbard still on.

ref_desc: Salasthambha is a lean early-30s Assamese ruler with medium-brown skin, shoulder-length black hair tied in a low knot with a red forehead band, wearing an off-white tunic, forest-green draped cloth, reddish-brown dhoti, leather belt and sandals, gold and bronze ornaments, and carrying a curved iron sword in a dark-brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Salasthambha of Kamarupa: a lean, early-30s Assamese man with medium-brown skin, high cheekbones, strong jaw, and sharp dark-brown eyes, a faint scar on his left cheek, and a calm, observant default expression with a slight half-smile. His thick black hair reaches just below his shoulders, parted and pulled back into a low knot at the nape, held by a plain bronze pin, with a narrow dark-red cloth band wrapped once around his forehead and tied at the back. Dress him in an off-white, knee-length cotton tunic with half sleeves and a subtle woven border, over which a deep forest-green silk angavastra-like cloth drapes from his left shoulder across his torso and under his right arm, its edges trimmed with narrow gold and red geometric patterns. He wears a reddish-brown cotton dhoti, tightly wrapped and pleated in front, falling to his ankles, and a broad dark-brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle cinching the tunic and supporting his weapon. On his feet are brown leather sandals with toe loops. Add a single slender gold armlet on his right upper arm, a plain bronze bangle on his left wrist, small round gold ear studs, and a necklace of alternating dark wooden and copper-toned beads. His signature weapon is a slightly curved iron sword with a plain bronze hilt in a dark-brown leather scabbard reinforced by bronze bands, worn angled at his left hip and shown also resting in his right hand still sheathed. Use a palette of off-white, forest green, reddish brown, dark brown, and gold, and present front, three-quarter, and back views to emphasize the consistent face, hairstyle, clothing layers, accessories, and sword placement.
